content: Always consult your healthcare provider to obtain comprehensive information about this product and to address your specific health needs. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Ensure proper disposal of this product when it has expired or is no longer required. This information was last updated in May 2024. It is important to understand how to use this information: it serves as a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. This information does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. It is not intended to replace individualized medical advice or the guidance of your healthcare provider. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to make informed comparisons. The information provided above is for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
